description: Track V ingest web-source roster — the machine-readable half of .claude/skills/ingest-newsletters/SKILL.md (policy stays in the skill; URLs + fetch mechanics live here). Driven by scripts/fetch-sources.mjs, which snapshots each source and emits .ingest-cache/changes.json so the ingest only spends model attention on sources that actually changed. fetch: "auto" = plain HTTP first, headless-browser fallback; "browser" = known to 403/JS-wall plain fetches. cadence: "monthly" sources are checked on the first Monday run of the month only.

sources.name: Greenpointers (RSS)
sources.notes: "What's Happening" roundup publishes WEDNESDAYS. Switched from the browser-only front page to the RSS feed 2026-08-05: the feed's content:encoded carries the FULL roundup body (times, venues, free-ness, RSVP links), so the snapshot is the article text itself — no browser, and no second fetch to the post URL to read items. The post URL is still in the diff; cite it as the sourceLink. Apply the Williamsburg-address gate per roundup item. The HTML site blocks plain WebFetch — go to the feed, not the page.

sources.name: Troost (Google Calendar API)
sources.notes: Switched 2026-08-05: troostny.com/calendar renders a client-side Google Calendar widget, so plain fetch saw nothing and it fell back to the browser. This is the exact request the site JS makes — calendar id and API key are both published in the page. IF THIS 403s, the key was rotated: re-fetch https://troostny.com/calendar/ and grep for "apikey:" to re-derive it. The public .ics was rejected as an alternative: it returns 731 events back to 2023, unsorted, with a DTSTAMP that changes every export, so every line diffs every run. CITE cards to https://troostny.com/calendar/.

sources.name: Eavesdrop
sources.notes: 674 Manhattan Ave. QUIET SINCE 2026-08-01, and that is ORGANIC — verified 2026-08-07, do not re-investigate. The /calendar page IS plain server-rendered HTML (h2 day headings + event rows), so plain fetch reaches it and extraction is correct: the snapshot carries all 24 day headings the HTML carries, Jun 27 through Aug 1, and the last event on the venue's own page is Sat Aug 1. There is nothing after it to fetch. A 2026-08-07 check briefly read this as a lossy-extraction bug by comparing the 1,745-char snapshot against 350,986 bytes of raw HTML — that ratio is meaningless, the HTML is almost entirely Tailwind class attributes. If this source is still showing Aug 1 as its last date in September, the venue has stopped maintaining the page and it should be dropped from the roster or re-pointed at their Instagram. RA PAGE CONSIDERED AND REJECTED AS A SOURCE (Batu asked, 2026-08-07): ra.co/clubs/194009 IS Eavesdrop (674 Manhattan Avenue, matches) and its calendar IS fresher than the venue's own site. It still cannot go in the roster. ra.co runs DataDome (x-datadome: protected, geo.captcha-delivery.com): plain fetch 403s, and headless Chromium is blocked outright by Cloudflare ('Sorry, you have been blocked'). RA's robots.txt does permit /clubs/, so a real browser read would have been legitimate — that was tried and blocked too, and getting past the block would mean defeating bot detection. DO NOT retry with stealth drivers, proxies, or challenge-solving, and do not re-litigate this each run. Honest routes instead: ask Eavesdrop to keep /calendar current, ask them for a feed, or have a human read RA in an interactive session and card from it.

sources.name: WORD Bookstore (Withfriends)
sources.notes: Batu 2026-08-05 confirmed this is where WORD publishes events (their own site bot-walls every method — IndieCommerce 403). Re-probed 2026-08-05 — /api/movement/word/events and ?format=json both return the same ~82KB empty SPA shell, .ics 500s. Do not re-hunt for an endpoint. Each event states its own location line, so the Brooklyn filter is mechanical: card ONLY "Greenpoint, Brooklyn" / "Brooklyn, NY" items, never "Jersey City, NJ". The list renders ~5 events behind a "Show more events..." control, so treat the snapshot as the near-term window, not the full calendar. ADDRESS RESOLVED (Batu, 2026-08-07): the Brooklyn store is 126 Franklin St, Brooklyn, NY 11222 — verified on WORD's own site footer, which lists exactly two locations (Brooklyn 126 Franklin St; Jersey City 29 McWilliams Pl). The Withfriends page's own blurb says it too: 'An independent bookstore since 2007 with locations in Greenpoint, Brooklyn and Jersey City, New Jersey.' So there is exactly ONE Brooklyn shop and it is in Greenpoint — a bare 'Brooklyn, NY' location line is unambiguous and pins to 126 Franklin St. This is what unblocks the three cards held 2026-08-06; the listing itself will still never print a street address, so DO NOT hold on that again. Accessibility, stated on the same page and worth carrying in card copy: 'Events in Brooklyn are held in the basement, accessed by a flight of stairs.' wordbookstores.com added to the tracked .claude/settings.json allowlist in the same change.

sources.name: GrowNYC — McCarren Park Greenmarket
sources.notes: Onboarded 2026-08-08 (ChatGPT cross-check found it uncarded). Plain WebFetch 403s — headless-browser fetch works and returns the static schedule page. STANDING PROGRAMMING: year-round Saturday market, 8am-3pm, Union Ave between Driggs & N12th St; compost drop-off Sat 8-1:30pm, clothing collection Sat 8:30am-1pm. Card is undated (mccarren-greenmarket) — this is a static schedule page so it will report `unchanged` most weeks; only re-author the card if the stated hours/services change. CADENCE DROPPED TO MONTHLY 2026-08-10. Re-probed that day and the 403 is a BLANKET EDGE BLOCK, not a UA rule and not our proxy: the roster URL, the www. variant and even /robots.txt all 403, with a real browser UA and without. Only a headless browser gets through, so while the Chromium CONNECT fault stands this source cannot be read at all and was contributing an error to every weekly and daily run. Monthly keeps it in the roster (it is the authoritative operator, and the card cites it) without paying that cost 6 days a week. VERIFICATION PATH MEANWHILE: nyc-open-data-farmers-markets carries this market’s day/hours/EBT/year-round status and agrees with the card. It does NOT carry the compost or clothing-collection hours, so those two lines are only re-verifiable here.

sources.name: Down to Earth Markets (McGolrick Park)
sources.notes: Onboarded 2026-08-10. Operator of the McGolrick Park Farmers Market (Sundays 9am-2pm, year-round, at the centre of the park off Russell St) — a standing Greenpoint market that no roster source covered and that was missing from the map entirely. Found via the NYC Open Data farmers-market dataset, then verified at the operator’s own site rather than carded off the dataset: Open Data’s newest row is 2025, so carding a 2026 market from it would have been inference. THE MARKET INFO IS ON THE HOMEPAGE, not a per-market page — there are no /markets/<slug>/ permalinks, and the WP REST API returns 2.2MB for a search without a McGolrick page in it. Plain fetch of the homepage is 2.2MB of HTML that htmlToText reduces to ~5k chars carrying the market block intact, so `auto` is correct and it never needs the browser. NOTE the market name and hours sit on SEPARATE LINES in the extraction (“McGolrick Park” then “Market open Sundays…”) — a single-line regex will miss it. Both www. and bare hosts resolve to https://downtoearthmarkets.com/, which is the host to allowlist. Also lists Park Slope and other non-Greenpoint markets: apply the geography gate per market.

sources.name: NYC Open Data — DOHMH Farmers Markets
sources.notes: Onboarded 2026-08-10 as the plain-fetchable verification path for markets whose operators are unreachable — grownyc.org sits behind a blanket edge WAF that 403s every non-browser client. Official DOHMH dataset, no WAF, 200 on a bare fetch. Carries marketname/borough/streetaddress/latitude/longitude/daysoperation/hoursoperations/accepts_ebt/open_year_round. MONTHLY BY DESIGN: the data is keyed by year and updated annually — as of 2026-08-10 the newest rows are 2025 — so it is a corroboration and discovery source, NEVER a substitute for the operator’s current page. DO NOT card a current-season market from it alone; that is how a 2025 row becomes a 2026 claim. It found the uncarded McGolrick market. Citywide, so the geography gate is per record: inside the Greenpoint bbox it returns McCarren (Sat), McGolrick (Sun) and Domino Park, and Domino is Williamsburg and out of scope per Batu 2026-08-06.

sources.name: Leaves Bookstore (calendar)
sources.notes: 140 Nassau Ave, Brooklyn NY 11222 (second-hand shop, open daily 10am-8pm). Onboarded 2026-08-08 at Batu's request — the calendar was carrying uncarded Greenpoint events and the source was in neither the roster nor the sender registry. BROWSER-ONLY: plain fetch gets HTTP 429 'Checking your browser… JavaScript is required' on the whole host; it reads fine in a real browser. Do not add UA tricks. RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-10 FROM A CLEAN PATH and the verdict holds — worth stating because TWO confounds applied when this was first diagnosed on 2026-08-08: plain fetch was silently egressing direct-and-intercepted (the NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY bug), and www.leavesbookstore.com was itself egress-denied at the proxy until the round-2 allowlist. Either could have faked a JS wall. Probed again from an interactive session with unrestricted egress and the script’s own browser UA: /events.php returns 406 with an empty body, the homepage returns 429 with a noindex ‘One moment…’ interstitial. So the challenge is real and this stays `browser`. TWO LOCATIONS — apply the geography gate PER EVENT: the Greenpoint shop (140 Nassau Ave) and an appointment-only rare book room in BUSHWICK (350 Harman St, 11237). The calendar mixes them ('midsommar collage night at leaves rare books' was Bushwick). The gate is mechanical: each event's DETAIL page at /pages/events/<id>/<slug> prints a 'location:' block with the street address — always open the detail page, never card off the list. READ THE BODY, NOT THE HEADER RANGE: their own listings emit reversed ranges (august book club shows 'wednesday august 5, 2026 - wednesday july 29, 2026'). That is a data error on their site. The real schedule is in the body text ('wednesdays from 8-9 pm'; the writing group body lists its exact dates). NEWSLETTER: Batu subscribed 2026-08-08 (leavesbookstore@buttondown.email) — in senderRegistry.

Shopify blog, so the .atom feed is the source of record — cheaper than the rendered /blogs/events page and carries the full entry body. Verified 2026-08-08: feed updated 2026-08-05 with "Summer Fridays listening party", "Summer Fridays After Hours", "Summer Poetry Open-Mic". Highest-yield find of that scan. Entry <updated> is the POST time, not the event date — read the event date out of the entry body, never from the timestamp. CITE cards to https://machastudio.com.

sources.name: Maison Jar (workshops)
sources.notes: 566 Leonard St, zero-waste grocery. Onboarded 2026-08-08 from the Shop Small Greenpoint directory scan. Workshops are listed on the HOMEPAGE (class="event" blocks), not on a dedicated events path — the directory's deep link is a text-fragment URL into the homepage, so the homepage is the real source. Verified 2026-08-08: 26 dated hits on plain fetch, e.g. a workshop on queer botany & native seed balls with a plant-based dinner. Plain fetch is sufficient; no browser needed.

sources.name: Lockwood (Facebook events via SociableKit feed)
sources.notes: 98 Greenpoint Ave. Onboarded 2026-08-08 from the Shop Small Greenpoint directory scan. THE RENDERED PAGE IS USELESS TO PLAIN FETCH: lockwoodshop.com/pages/events is 314KB of Shopify HTML that does not contain a single event — the listing is a SociableKit "Facebook Page Events" widget that hydrates from this JSON endpoint at runtime. Widget embed id 66424 is stable and mirrors Lockwood's Facebook page events. Verified 2026-08-08: "Tote-ally 20 Sale!", Aug 14-16 2026. Low volume (often 1 event) but the fetch is a single cheap GET. If the endpoint ever 404s, re-read the widget id from a browser load of /pages/events rather than assuming the source is dead. CITE cards to https://lockwoodshop.com/pages/events, never to data.accentapi.com.

sources.name: Greek Kitchen (daily specials)
sources.notes: 912 Manhattan Ave. Onboarded 2026-08-08 from the Shop Small Greenpoint directory scan. STANDING PROGRAMMING: a recurring Sat-through-Thu day-of-week specials rota, not dated one-offs — card it undated as a deal, and expect `unchanged` most weeks. Verified 2026-08-08: 7 day-of-week hits on plain fetch. Re-author only when the rota itself changes; do NOT mint a dated card per day.

sources.name: Sparrow Nesting (events blog Atom)
sources.notes: 159-161 Driggs Ave, gift shop attached to Sparrow Funerals. Onboarded 2026-08-08 from the Shop Small Greenpoint directory scan. LOW YIELD BY DESIGN and deliberately on monthly cadence: last feed update 2026-06-23, a handful of entries a year ("A Gathering for End of Life Doulas", "GRASP Grief Recovery"). Kept because the feed costs one plain GET and the supply — grief support and end-of-life community gatherings — is genuinely uncovered by every other source on the roster. A quiet month here is the expected state, not a fault.

sources.name: Happy Medium — Art Cafe
sources.notes: 224 Franklin St. Onboarded 2026-08-08 from the Shop Small Greenpoint directory scan. STANDING PROGRAMMING: drop-in Art Cafe sessions run ~8-10 slots a day continuously ($15 deposit) — this is one undated card, NOT a dated card per session. FILTER PER ITEM IF YOU EVER READ SESSIONS: the schedule interleaves two locations, "Greenpoint" and "Market Street" (Manhattan) — apply the geography gate exactly as for WORD/Jersey City. FETCH COST, KNOWN: the plain path returns ~48 chars because the schedule hydrates from a POST to /api/graphql, which the json strategy cannot call (it issues GETs). So `auto` will fall through to the headless browser here — this is a browser-dependent source in practice, and it counts against the 15% error ceiling during a browser outage. It is accepted anyway because a standing card changes rarely; if the browser path is down, treat this source as known-state, not a new failure.

sources.name: Brooklyn Hearts Club (adult art club)
sources.notes: Hosted at Madeline's, 117 Franklin St. Onboarded 2026-08-08 from the Shop Small Greenpoint directory scan. STANDING PROGRAMMING: adult art club, EVERY SECOND WEDNESDAY of the month — card it undated against that recurrence rule. The club has no site of its own; the linktr.ee is the only public URL and it carries no dates, so the recurrence rule is sourced from the Shop Small Greenpoint directory entry itself (that is the sourceQuote of record, not the linktree). NOTE THE VENUE SPLIT: the club is the organiser, Madeline's is the address — the card belongs at 117 Franklin St.

sources.name: Edy's Grocer (ticketed dinners)
sources.notes: 136 Meserole Ave, Lebanese market and deli. Onboarded 2026-08-08 from the Shop Small Greenpoint directory scan. Events are sold as SQUARESPACE COMMERCE PRODUCTS, not calendar entries — verified 2026-08-08 with "Dinner at the Grocer with Silvia Barban", $95, sold out. GOOD NEWS ON DATES: `excerpt` usually carries the whole thing — verified 2026-08-08, the Barban excerpt states "On Tuesday, July 28th", both seatings (6:00 PM and 8:30 PM), the address, and the ticketing terms. So most items are cardable from the snapshot alone. TWO TRAPS. (1) `publishOn` is an epoch-ms PUBLISH time, NOT the event date — never derive a card date from it; the date comes from the excerpt prose, and if the excerpt has no date, follow fullUrl before carding (an item with no confirmable date does not ship, R1). (2) `fullUrl` is RELATIVE ("/shop/p/...") — prefix https://edysgrocer.com when citing. A sold-out dinner is still worth carding as neighbourhood signal but must say sold out.

sources.name: Held Space (membership)
sources.notes: 960 Manhattan Ave, 4th Floor. Onboarded 2026-08-08 to WATCH THE PRICES on held-space-membership — the card quotes $129/month or $1029/year (2 months free) plus Practitioner from $329 and Facilitator from $396, and nothing was re-verifying them. STANDING PROGRAMMING: the tiers are the supply, so the card is undated; a diff here means a price or tier changed, which is a card update, not a new card. The members-only programme ("at least 2x per week" — yoga, ecstatic dance, sound baths, communal coworking) is real but NOT publicly dated anywhere we can reach, so do not expect event cards from this source. Note the SSG directory's event URL for this business (/attend-an-offering) 404s — do not restore it.

sources.name: Selformer (plans & pricing)
sources.notes: 67 West St. Onboarded 2026-08-08 to watch the prices on selformer-memberships ($147/$239/$369 a month for 4/8/16 classes; $399 unlimited; $350 on-demand video). TWO LOCATIONS — plans read "Williamsburg + Greenpoint" and the self-service station is Williamsburg-only, so never write a Greenpoint-exclusive benefit into card copy. The BOOKING page (/book-now) is login-walled Wix auth and carries nothing; this pricing page is the public surface — do not re-probe the booking path. Time-boxed promos appear here (a "Summer Fling Unlimited" $249/mo ran through Aug 15 2026 and was deliberately NOT carded — a deal that dies in a week is not worth a slot); card those only as `discount` WITH endsAt.

sources.name: Clay Space (membership)
sources.notes: 275 Calyer St. Watches the prices on clay-space-membership: four tiers $210-$255 / $310-$380 / $365-$525 / $485-$650 + tax monthly, 3-month minimum, application-gated, requires more than a year of consistent lessons.

sources.name: Clay Space (workshops)
sources.notes: 275 Calyer St. THIS is Clay Space's live dated supply, and finding it corrected a 2026-08-08 miss: the roster scan had rejected the business on /events, which lists only PAST events (the newest was Jun 12 against an Aug 8 scan) — the conclusion "Clay Space publishes nothing current" was drawn from the wrong page. Workshops are one-off, named, and forward-dated in prose ("Upcoming dates: August 29-30 + Sept 2"), NOT in a machine-readable field, so read the dates from the visible text. Many entries say "Fall 2026 (tba)" — those are NOT cardable until a real date appears. Plain fetch reaches the full list; no browser needed.

sources.name: Clay Space (semester classes)
sources.notes: 275 Calyer St. Term registration, so `subscription` on the audience lens, never deals_memberships (same rule as the YMCA and the ballet term). Fall 2026: Sunday September 13 to Saturday December 12, 12-week session, $760 per full semester ($900 independent study), public registration opens Aug 10 2026. Winter 2027 (January-March) is stated to release in late November — expect the page to turn over then. The registration-opens date is the newsworthy beat here, not the semester start.

sources.name: Driftaway Coffee (subscriptions)

sources.name: Otis & Finn Barbershop (community)
sources.notes: 197 Franklin St. Onboarded 2026-08-08 alongside the email sender Batu subscribed to. EXPECT LOW WEB YIELD BY DESIGN: this page describes the programme ("annual free Back-to-School Haircutting Event", Pride Party) but publishes NO dates — it is an email-signup page, so the SENDER is the real source and this URL is the standing description. Marked standing:true so the L12 UNMARKED STANDING signal stays quiet. The Back-to-School haircut event is an August beat: watch the sender for it rather than waiting on this page to sprout a date.

sources.name: CIBONE O'TE
sources.notes: 50 Norman Ave, inside the 50 Norman complex. Onboarded 2026-08-08 from a newsletter Batu forwarded (the Re:STATION archival showcase). LOCALLY-OWNED EXCEPTION — READ BEFORE SKIPPING: CIBONE lists Tokyo Omotesando and Ginza alongside Brooklyn, so the 2026-07-16 locally-owned gate (the rule that dropped PRESS for being multi-location) would skip it. Batu ruled 50 Norman IN on 2026-08-08: its tenants (CIBONE, Kama-Asa, Dashi Okume, Cafe O'te) get venue and event cards like any local business. Do not re-litigate this each run. Shopify Atom feed, not the HTML blog — /blogs/news.atom carries the full post bodies (dates, hours, address), so no browser and no second fetch to the post URL. WHAT TO CARD: month-long curated showcases and limited events (Re:STATION, HOZUBAG, glass/ceramics debuts), which is most of what this blog publishes. They state a run range and 'Store Hours: 11am - 8pm' rather than a single event time — card as a dated event spanning the run, ending at closing time on the last day. Marked standing:false so the L12 UNMARKED STANDING signal stays quiet: the blog announces limited runs, it publishes no recurring weekly programme.
